title.zh: 【慢雾 CISO 推测 Ledger 设备被攻击路径：旁路录屏助记词后再外传】
title.en: 【慢雾 CISO 推测 Ledger 设备被攻击路径：旁路录屏助记词后再外传】

current_state.zh: SlowMist's CISO outlined how a tampered Ledger device could record the mnemonic words from the screen's SPI data lines and exfiltrate them via an embedded LTE/eSIM module, following Mark Karpelès' report of receiving a Ledger with a hidden spy module.
